     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOnePresentation
     7	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    95	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    97	
    98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
    99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   105	
   106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   110	
   111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   112	
   113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   115	relative-open gate below. -/
   116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   120	
   121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   122	
   123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   128	
   129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   130	
   131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   132	
   133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   141	  W : X.Opens
   142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   144	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   152	
   153	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   154	
   155	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   156	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   157	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   158	
   159	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   161	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   162	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   163	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   164	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   165	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   166	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   167	      φ.app S) D.sq
   168	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   169	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   170	  · intro v w hvw
   171	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   172	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   173	
   174	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   175	
   176	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   177	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   178	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   179	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   180	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
   181	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   182	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   183	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   184	  intro X g
   185	  let d := D X g
   186	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   187	
   188	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   189	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   190	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   191	  h
   192	
   193	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   194	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   195	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   196	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   197	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   200	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   201	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   202	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   203	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   204	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   205	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   206	
   207	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   208	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   209	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   210	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   211	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   212	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   213	
   214	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   215	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   216	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   217	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   218	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   219	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   220	
   221	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   222	
   223	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   224	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   225	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   226	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   227	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   228	
   229	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
   230	representer. -/
   231	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
   232	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
   233	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
   234	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   235	
   236	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   237	def rankOneAbelAff :
   238	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
   239	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   240	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   241	
   242	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   243	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
   244	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   245	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
   246	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
   247	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   248	
   249	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   250	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
   251	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   252	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   253	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
   254	
   255	/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
   256	The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
   257	theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
   258	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   259	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   260	    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
   261	      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
   262	  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property
   263	
   264	end
   265	
   266	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route
    11	
    12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
    13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
    14	
    15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
    16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
    17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.
    18	
    19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
    20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
    21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
    22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
    23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    37	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	variable (C n) in
    42	/-- The widened Abel transformation into the intrinsic degree-`n` Picard layer. -/
    43	def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
    44	  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
    45	  naturality T T' g := by
    46	    ext s
    47	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    48	    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm
    49	
    50	@[simp]
    51	lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    52	    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    53	    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
    54	  rfl
    55	
    56	variable (C n) in
    57	/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
    58	def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    59	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
    60	    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
    61	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
    62	  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)
    63	
    64	@[simp]
    65	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_fst {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    66	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    67	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    68	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_coe {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    73	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
    76	      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=
    77	  rfl
    78	
    79	variable (C) in
    80	/-- The ambient genus-degree Abel map on the canonical represented widened divisor scheme.
    81	
    82	This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to
    83	be an open immersion. -/
    84	def abelDivAffGenusSigma :
    85	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶
    86	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
    87	  abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)
    88	
    89	end
    90	
    91	end AlgebraicGeometry

     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Restrict
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The universal divisor rank-one open contract
    11	
    12	The genus divisor representer is unconditional, while the rank-one restriction still needs a
    13	family-level open-locus producer.  This file separates those two facts.  The predicate below is
    14	the inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` along the represented universal Abel map.  A
    15	`DivRankOneOpenData` witness identifies that predicate with the range of one actual open of the
    16	representer; only after that witness is supplied do we define the open subscheme.
    17	
    18	This shape prevents a logical `Subfunctor` from being silently reinterpreted as a scheme.  It also
    19	gives the canonical inverse lane a stable contract: it consumes the witness equality and can use
    20	the resulting open inclusion and all of its pullbacks without choosing a generator.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    29	
    30	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    31	
    32	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    33	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    34	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    35	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	/-- The universal genus-divisor predicate whose Abel class lies in `PicRankOneOpen`. -/
    40	def divRankOneUniversalPredicate :
    41	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    42	  divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi
    43	
    44	/-- Evaluation of the represented genus Abel map on a slice point, with the base morphism
    45	transported from the point in the divisor representer to its source. -/
    46	theorem abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne
    47	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    48	    (q : T ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C) :
    49	    (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.left) q.left =
    50	      (⟨T.hom,
    51	        (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    52	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩ :
    53	        (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    54	          (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) := by
    55	  change (⟨q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom, _⟩ :
    56	      (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	        (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj (op T.left)) =
    58	    ⟨T.hom,
    59	      (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    60	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)⟩
    61	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext
    62	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) q.w ?_
    63	  let e : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶ T :=
    64	    Over.mkCongr q.w
    65	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom) ⟶
    66	      divRepAffGenusScheme C :=
    67	    Over.homMk q.left rfl
    68	  have hq : e ≫ q = q' := by
    69	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    70	    exact Category.id_comp _
    71	  change (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map e.op
    72	      ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T)
    73	        ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)) =
    74	    (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app
    75	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)))
    76	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q')
    77	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    78	    ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).naturality e.op)
    79	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q)
    80	  have hhom :
    81	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =
    82	        (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).map e.op
    83	          ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q) := by
    84	    calc
    85	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv q' =

    94	/-- A represented genus divisor lies in the universal predicate exactly when its Abel image
    95	lifts through the single public rank-one Picard locus. -/
    96	theorem divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma
    97	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    98	    (x : (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)).obj T) :
    99	    x ∈ (divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi).obj T ↔
   100	      ∃ v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   101	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (op T.unop.left),
   102	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left) v =
   103	          (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left := by
   104	  simp only [divRankOneUniversalPredicate,
   105	    divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter,
   106	    Subfunctor.preimage_obj, Set.mem_preimage]
   107	  let p := (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app T
   108	    ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).homEquiv x)
   109	  change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔ _
   110	  have hleft :
   111	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) x.left =
   112	        (⟨T.unop.hom, p⟩ :
   113	          (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
   114	            (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))).obj
   115	              (op T.unop.left)) :=
   116	    abelDivAffGenusSigma_app_left_rankOne x
   117	  constructor
   118	  · intro hp
   119	    refine ⟨⟨T.unop.hom, ⟨p, hp⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   120	    rw [hleft]
   121	    rfl
   122	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   123	    rw [hleft] at hv
   124	    dsimp [picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   125	      CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat] at hv
   126	    rcases v with ⟨a, y⟩
   127	    dsimp at hv
   128	    have hfirst : a = T.unop.hom :=
   129	      congrArg (fun z => z.1) hv
   130	    cases hfirst
   131	    have hinj := Sigma.mk.inj hv
   132	    have heq :
   133	        ConcreteCategory.hom
   134	            ((PicRankOneOpen pi).ι.app
   135	              (op (Over.mk T.unop.hom))) y = p :=
   136	      eq_of_heq hinj.2
   137	    change p ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T
   138	    rw [← heq]
   139	    exact y.property

   141	/-- The Yoneda map induced by the inclusion of an open of an object in the slice.  Naming this
   142	map is useful to consumers which need the actual factorisation through the open, rather than only
   143	the proposition that a point lies in its range. -/
   144	def openSubfunctorMap (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   145	    yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) ⟶ yoneda.obj D :=
   146	  yoneda.map (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom)) U.ι)
   147	
   148	/-- The subfunctor represented by an open `U` of an object `D` in the slice over `Spec k`.
   149	
   150	Its values are precisely morphisms which factor through the open immersion `U.ι`; using the
   151	Yoneda range keeps this definition independent of any chosen affine presentation of `U`. -/
   152	def openSubfunctor (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens) :
   153	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj D) :=
   154	  Subfunctor.range (openSubfunctorMap D U)

   156	/-- Unpack range membership into the actual source point and its equality in the ambient Yoneda
   157	functor.  This is the pointwise factorisation API used by inverse constructions. -/
   158	theorem openSubfunctor_mem_iff
   159	    (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : D.left.Opens)
   160	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   161	    (x : (yoneda.obj D).obj T) :
   162	    x ∈ (openSubfunctor D U).obj T ↔
   163	      ∃ y : (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (U.ι ≫ D.hom))).obj T,
   164	        (openSubfunctorMap D U).app T y = x := by
   165	  rfl

   167	/-- An explicit geometric certificate for the universal rank-one predicate.
   168	
   169	The equality is the missing family-level producer/gluing statement: it identifies the logical
   170	preimage with an actual open of the canonical genus representer.  No default or top-open witness
   171	is manufactured here. -/
   172	structure DivRankOneOpenData (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] where
   173	  carrier : (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left.Opens
   174	  carrier_eq :
   175	    openSubfunctor (divRepAffGenusScheme C) carrier =
   176	      divRankOneUniversalPredicate pi
   177	
   178	/-- Genuine relative openness of the public Picard rank-one locus produces the universal
   179	divisor rank-one open.  The carrier is the open image of the represented pullback of the Abel
   180	map, and the proof below identifies its Yoneda range with the defining predicate. -/
   181	theorem divRankOneOpenData_of_picRankOneOpen_isOpen
   182	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) :
   183	    Nonempty (DivRankOneOpenData pi) := by
   184	  obtain ⟨X, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := h.rep (abelDivAffGenusSigma C)
   185	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   186	    h.property (abelDivAffGenusSigma C) fst snd hpb
   187	  let U := snd.opensRange
   188	  refine ⟨⟨U, ?_⟩⟩
   189	  ext T x
   190	  rw [openSubfunctor_mem_iff]
   191	  rw [divRankOneUniversalPredicate_mem_iff_sigma]
   192	  have hpbT := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op T.unop.left)
   193	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbT
   194	  constructor
   195	  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
   196	    have hxy : x.left = y.left ≫ U.ι := by
   197	      have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hy
   198	      exact hleft.symm
   199	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range snd.base := by
   200	      rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange snd]
   201	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   202	      rw [hxy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
   203	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ snd.opensRange
   204	      change U.ι.base (y.left.base t) ∈ U
   205	      exact (y.left.base t).property
   206	    let u : T.unop.left ⟶ X :=
   207	      IsOpenImmersion.lift snd x.left hrange
   208	    have hu : u ≫ snd = x.left :=
   209	      IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   210	    refine ⟨fst.app (op T.unop.left) u, ?_⟩
   211	    have hcomm := congrArg
   212	      (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) u) hpbT.1
   213	    change (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op T.unop.left)
   214	        (fst.app (op T.unop.left) u) =
   215	      (abelDivAffGenusSigma C).app (op T.unop.left) (u ≫ snd) at hcomm
   216	    simpa only [hu] using hcomm
   217	  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
   218	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := hpbT.2.2 v x.left hv
   219	    change u ≫ snd = x.left at hu₂
   220	    have hrange : Set.range x.left.base ⊆ Set.range U.ι.base := by
   221	      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
   222	      change Set.range x.left.base ⊆ snd.opensRange
   223	      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
   224	      rintro z ⟨t, rfl⟩
   225	      refine ⟨u.base t, ?_⟩
   226	      have happ := congrArg (fun f => f.base t) hu₂
   227	      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using happ
   228	    let V : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   229	      Over.mk (U.ι ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   230	    let j : V ⟶ divRepAffGenusScheme C :=

231	      Over.homMk (U := V) U.ι
   232	    let e : U.toScheme = V.left := rfl
   233	    let l : T.unop.left ⟶ U.toScheme :=
   234	      IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι x.left hrange
   235	    let l' : T.unop.left ⟶ V.left := l ≫ eqToHom e
   236	    have he : eqToHom e ≫ j.left = U.ι := by
   237	      subst e
   238	      rfl
   239	    have hl : l' ≫ j.left = x.left := by
   240	      dsimp only [l']
   241	      rw [Category.assoc, he]
   242	      dsimp only [l]
   243	      exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
   244	    have hlw : l' ≫ V.hom = T.unop.hom := by
   245	      rw [← j.w, ← Category.assoc, hl]
   246	      exact x.w
   247	    let y : (yoneda.obj V).obj T := Over.homMk l' hlw
   248	    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
   249	    change y ≫ j = x
   250	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   251	    exact hl

    11	
    12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
    13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
    14	
    15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
    16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
    17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.
    18	
    19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
    20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
    21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
    22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
    23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.

    48	    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm

    74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
    76	      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=

    80	/-- The ambient genus-degree Abel map on the canonical represented widened divisor scheme.

    82	This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to

    84	def abelDivAffGenusSigma :

     9	/-!
    10	# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring
    11	
    12	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
    13	`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
    14	scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
    15	compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
    16	cohomology engine.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    28	
    29	/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
    30	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    31	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    32	    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
    33	  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)
    34	
    35	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections
    36	
    37	/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
    38	private noncomputable def smulSection
    39	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    40	    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
    41	  r • x
    42	
    43	/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
    44	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    45	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    46	    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
    48	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    49	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
    50	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    51	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
    53	          (congrArg
    54	            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
    55	              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
    56	            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
    57	  map_id U := by
    58	    ext x
    59	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
    60	      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
    61	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    62	    ext x
    63	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
    64	      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
    65	
    66	/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
    67	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    68	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    69	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
    70	      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
    71	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
    72	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    73	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl
    74	
    75	/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
    76	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    77	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    78	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    79	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩
    80	
    81	/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
    82	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    83	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    84	    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    85	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    86	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
    87	      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	namespace Modules
    91	
    92	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    93	
    94	/-- A scheme module which is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf. -/
    95	def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
    96	  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    97	    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    98	
    99	end Modules
   100	
   101	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

   156	/-! ## The degree-zero term base change and the δ-naturality square -/

   158	/-- The base change of the two-cover degree-zero term `F(V₀ᴮ) × F(V₁ᴮ)`. -/
   159	noncomputable def datumDomBaseChange :
   160	    B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   161	        (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) ≃ₗ[B']

   163	        ((D.baseChange B').sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)) :=

   165	    ((D.termBaseChange₀ B').prodCongr (D.termBaseChange₁ B'))

   167	/-- The degree-zero term base change on a pure tensor. -/

   169	    (p : (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   170	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :

   172	      (D.termBaseChange₀ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.1), D.termBaseChange₁ B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p.2)) := by
   173	  rw [datumDomBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, TensorProduct.prodRight_tmul]

   176	set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
   177	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   178	/-- **The δ-naturality square** (the glued analogue of `relTwistDiffBaseChange`): the base
   179	change of the datum's Čech differential over `B` is carried to the datum's Čech differential
   180	over `B'` under the term identifications. There is no cocycle conjugation — the componentwise
   181	restrictions commute with `sectionsMap` through `gluedRes_sectionsMap`. -/

   183	    (x : B' ⊗[B] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)) ×
   184	      (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)))) :
   185	    D.termBaseChangeInf B' (((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' x) =
   186	      (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff (D.datumDomBaseChange B' x) := by
   187	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   188	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
   189	  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
   190	  | tmul b' p =>
   191	    have hbc : ((datumPair D).diff).baseChange B' (b' ⊗ₜ[B] p) =
   192	        b' ⊗ₜ[B] (datumPair D).diff p := LinearMap.baseChange_tmul _ _ _
   193	    rw [hbc]
   194	    simp only [D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul B', TwoLatticePair.diff_apply,
   195	      D.termBaseChange₀_tmul B', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul B']
   196	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub, map_sub, D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B',
   197	      D.termBaseChangeInf_tmul B', map_smul, map_smul]
   198	    congr 1
   199	    · congr 1
   200	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   201	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   202	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   203	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₀)
   204	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   205	        (inf_le_left : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   206	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀)
   207	        p.1).symm
   208	    · congr 1
   209	      exact (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
   210	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   211	          (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   212	        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover π).V₁)
   213	        (le_preimage_chart B' ((fiberTwoCover π).V₀ ⊓ (fiberTwoCover π).V₁))
   214	        (inf_le_right : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   215	          (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ ≤ (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)
   216	        p.2).symm
   217	
   218	/-! ## The on-the-nose H⁰ base change and H¹ vanishing -/
   219	
   220	open AlgebraicJacobian
   221	
   222	/-- **`H⁰` base change on the nose** (DAT-1 (1d-ii) tail; the RE-5/DAT-B transport interface):
   223	on the vanishing locus, for every ring map `B → B'`,
   224	
   225	`B' ⊗[B] H⁰(C_B, F_D) ≃ₗ[B'] H⁰(C_{B'}, F_{D'})`
   226	
   227	with `D' = D.baseChange B'` — the abstract kernel clause `datumH0BaseChangeEquiv` threaded
   228	through the term identifications by the δ-naturality square `datumDiffBaseChange`. -/
   229	noncomputable def datumH0BaseChange (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1) :
   230	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   231	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 :=
   232	  (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 B').trans

   234	        ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff)

     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Canonical pushforward base change for scheme modules
    10	
    11	For a cartesian square of schemes, `canonicalBaseChangeMap` is the Beck--Chevalley mate
    12	
    13	```text
    14	g^* f_* M --> f'_* (g')^* M.
    15	```
    16	
    17	The two coherence theorems identify its pullback followed by the counit with the pullback of
    18	the original counit.  Invertibility is deliberately not asserted here: it is a property of the
    19	module and square, not part of the construction of the canonical map.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-- The canonical Beck--Chevalley mate for pushforward along a cartesian square. -/
    31	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
    32	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    33	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    34	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    35	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
    36	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
    37	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
    38	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    39	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
    40	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    41	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    42	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)
    43	
    44	/-- Pulling back the canonical mate and evaluating recovers its defining pullback telescope. -/
    45	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit
    46	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    47	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    48	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    49	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    50	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    51	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) =
    52	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    53	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    54	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom).app
    55	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    56	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    57	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    58	  rw [canonicalBaseChangeMap]
    59	  exact CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_counit _ _ _ M
    60	
    61	/-- After cancelling the pullback telescope, the base-changed counit is the pulled-back
    62	original counit. -/
    63	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel
    64	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    65	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    66	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    67	    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    68	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    69	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).inv).app
    70	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    71	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    72	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    73	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)) =
    74	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    75	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    76	  erw [canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit]
    77	  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    78	  rfl
    79	
    80	end AlgebraicGeometry

     7	/-!
     8	# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum
     9	
    10	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
    11	ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
    12	modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
    13	that bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on every open,
    14	`gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
    15	`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
    16	restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	The canonical piece trivializations also prove that the native module is a line
    19	bundle.  Pushforward base-change and existence of a tied
    20	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` remain genuine producer obligations.
    21	-/

    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

    36	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    41	
    42	/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.
    43	
    44	The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
    45	are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
    46	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
    47	    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    48	      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
    49	  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    50	    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
    51	  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
    52	      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
    53	    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
    54	  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    55	    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    56	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    57	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    58	    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)
    59

    61	noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
    62	  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    63	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
    64	  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    65	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    66	    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop

    68	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
    69	  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    70	    intro X Y f r m
    71	    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
    72	        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
    73	      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
    74	        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
    75	        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)

    78	    funext j
    79	    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    80	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])

     8	/-!
     9	# Canonical pushforward base change for scheme modules
    10	
    11	For a cartesian square of schemes, `canonicalBaseChangeMap` is the Beck--Chevalley mate
    12	
    13	```text
    14	g^* f_* M --> f'_* (g')^* M.
    15	```
    16	
    17	The two coherence theorems identify its pullback followed by the counit with the pullback of
    18	the original counit.  Invertibility is deliberately not asserted here: it is a property of the
    19	module and square, not part of the construction of the canonical map.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-- The canonical Beck--Chevalley mate for pushforward along a cartesian square. -/
    31	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
    32	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    33	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    34	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    35	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
    36	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
    37	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
    38	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    39	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
    40	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    41	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    42	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)
    43	
    44	/-- Pulling back the canonical mate and evaluating recovers its defining pullback telescope. -/
    45	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit
    46	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    47	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    48	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    49	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    50	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    51	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) =
    52	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    53	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    54	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom).app
    55	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    56	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    57	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    58	  rw [canonicalBaseChangeMap]
    59	  exact CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_counit _ _ _ M
    60	
    61	/-- After cancelling the pullback telescope, the base-changed counit is the pulled-back
    62	original counit. -/
    63	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel
    64	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    65	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    66	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    67	    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    68	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    69	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).inv).app
    70	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    71	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    72	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    73	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)) =
    74	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    75	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    76	  erw [canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit]
    77	  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    78	  rfl

variable (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g]

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
/-- Restriction of an `𝒪ₓ`-module along an open immersion.
This is isomorphic to the pullback functor (see `restrictFunctorIsoPullback`)
but has better defeqs. -/
def restrictFunctor : Y.Modules ⥤ X.Modules :=
  letI α : X.presheaf ⟶ f.opensFunctor.op ⋙ Y.presheaf := { app U := (f.appIso U.unop).inv }
  SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := f.opensFunctor)
    ⟨Functor.whiskerRight α (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩

/-- The restriction of a module along an open immersion. -/
abbrev restrict (M : Y.Modules) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] : X.Modules :=
  (restrictFunctor f).obj M

/-- The sections of the restriction of `M` over `U` are isomorphic to `Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U). -/
def restrictAppIso (M : Y.Modules) (U : X.Opens) : Γ(M.restrict f, U) ≅ Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U) :=
  Iso.refl _

@[elementwise (attr := simp), reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_restrictAppIso_hom (M : Y.Modules) (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    dsimp% (M.restrict f).smul r ≫ (M.restrictAppIso f U).hom =
      (M.restrictAppIso f U).hom ≫ M.smul ((f.appIso U).inv r) :=
  rfl

@[elementwise (attr := simp), reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma smul_restrictAppIso_inv (M : Y.Modules) (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(Y, f ''ᵁ U)) :
    M.smul r ≫ (M.restrictAppIso f U).inv =
      (M.restrictAppIso f U).inv ≫ (M.restrict f).smul ((f.appIso U).hom r) := by
  simp [← cancel_mono (M.restrictAppIso f U).hom]

@[elementwise (attr := simp), reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma map_restrictAppIso_hom (M : Y.Modules) {U V : X.Opens}
    (hUV : Opposite.op V ⟶ .op U) :
    (M.restrict f).presheaf.map hUV ≫ (M.restrictAppIso f U).hom =
      (M.restrictAppIso f V).hom ≫
      M.presheaf.map (.op <| homOfLE <| Scheme.Hom.image_mono _ (leOfHom hUV.unop)) := by
  rfl

@[elementwise (attr := simp), reassoc (attr := simp)]
lemma restrictAppIso_inv_map (M : Y.Modules) {U V : X.Opens} (hUV : .op V ⟶ .op U) :
    (M.restrictAppIso f V).inv ≫ (M.restrict f).presheaf.map hUV =
      M.presheaf.map (.op <| homOfLE <| Scheme.Hom.image_mono _ (leOfHom hUV.unop)) ≫
      (M.restrictAppIso f U).inv :=
  rfl

/-- Avoid using this. Use the isomorphism `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso`
instead. -/
lemma restrict_obj (M : Y.Modules) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] (U) :
    Γ(M.restrict f, U) = Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U) := rfl

/-- Avoid using this. Use the isomorphism `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso`
instead. -/
lemma restrict_map (M : Y.Modules) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] {U V} (i : U ⟶ V) :
    (M.restrict f).presheaf.map i.op = M.presheaf.map (f.opensFunctor.map i).op := rfl

/-- The restriction of a module along an open immersion. -/
def restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso : pushforward f ⋙ restrictFunctor f ≅ 𝟭 _ :=
  letI := CategoryTheory.Functor.isContinuous_comp.{u} f.opensFunctor (Opens.map f.base)
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
  (SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp _ _) ≪≫ pushforwardNatIso _ (NatIso.ofComponents
      (fun U ↦ eqToIso (f.preimage_image_eq U).symm) fun _ ↦ rfl) ≪≫
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr (by ext U x; exact
      congr($(f.appIso_inv_app_presheafMap U.unop) x)) ≪≫ SheafOfModules.pushforwardId _

/-- Restriction is right adjoint to pushforward. -/
def restrictAdjunction : restrictFunctor f ⊣ pushforward f := by
  refine pushforwardPushforwardAdj (by exact f.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.adjunction) _ _ ?_ ?_
  · ext U x; exact congr($((f.app_appIso_inv _).symm).hom x)
  · ext U x
    have : (f.appIso U.unop).inv ≫ f.app _ ≫
      X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (f.preimage_image_eq U.unop).symm).op = 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_app_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, ← X.presheaf.map_id]; rfl
    exact congr($this x)

instance : IsIso (restrictAdjunction f).counit :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsIso <| (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso f).hom)

instance : (restrictFunctor f).IsLeftAdjoint := (restrictAdjunction f).isLeftAdjoint
instance : (pushforward f).Full := (restrictAdjunction f).fullyFaithfulROfIsIsoCounit.full
instance : (pushforward f).Faithful := (restrictAdjunction f).fullyFaithfulROfIsIsoCounit.faithful

@[simp]
lemma restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app (M : Y.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ((restrictAdjunction f).unit.app M).app U =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (f.image_preimage_le U)).op := rfl

@[simp]
lemma restrictAdjunction_counit_app_app (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) :
    ((restrictAdjunction f).counit.app M).app U =
      M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (f.preimage_image_eq U).symm).op := rfl

/-- Restriction is naturally isomorphic to the inverse image. -/
def restrictFunctorIsoPullback : restrictFunctor f ≅ pullback f :=
  (restrictAdjunction f).leftAdjointUniq (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
/-- Restriction along the identity is isomorphic to the identity. -/
def restrictFunctorId : restrictFunctor (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _ :=
  SheafOfModules.pushforwardNatIso _ (NatIso.ofComponents (fun _ ↦ eqToIso (by simp))) ≪≫
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr
      (by ext : 3; simp [← Functor.map_comp, SheafedSpace.sheaf]) ≪≫
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardId _

@[simp]
lemma restrictFunctorId_hom_app_app :
    (restrictFunctorId.hom.app M).app U =
      M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (show U = 𝟙 X ''ᵁ U by simp)).op := rfl

@[simp]
lemma restrictFunctorId_inv_app_app :
    (restrictFunctorId.inv.app M).app U =
      M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (show 𝟙 X ''ᵁ U = U by simp)).op := rfl

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
/-- Restriction along the composition is isomorphic to the composition of restrictions. -/
def restrictFunctorComp : restrictFunctor (f ≫ g) ≅ restrictFunctor g ⋙ restrictFunctor f :=
  have : (f.opensFunctor ⋙ g.opensFunctor).IsContinuous
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) :=
    Functor.isContinuous_comp _ _ _ (Opens.grothendieckTopology _) _
  SheafOfModules.pushforwardNatIso _ (NatIso.ofComponents fun _ ↦ eqToIso (by simp)) ≪≫
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr (by ext : 3; simp [← Functor.map_comp, SheafedSpace.sheaf]) ≪≫
    (SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp _ _).symm

@[simp]
lemma restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app (M : Z.Modules) :
    ((restrictFunctorComp f g).hom.app M).app U = M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (by simp)).op := rfl

@[simp]
lemma restrictFunctorComp_inv_app_app (M : Z.Modules) :
    ((restrictFunctorComp f g).inv.app M).app U = M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (by simp)).op := rfl

set_option backward.defeqAttrib.useBackward true in
/-- Restriction along equal morphisms are isomorphic. -/
def restrictFunctorCongr {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = g) [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g] :
    restrictFunctor f ≅ restrictFunctor g :=
  SheafOfModules.pushforwardNatIso _ (NatIso.ofComponents fun _ ↦ eqToIso (by simp [hf])) ≪≫
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr (by ext : 3; subst hf; simp)

@[simp]
lemma restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = g) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    [IsOpenImmersion g] (M : Y.Modules) :
    ((restrictFunctorCongr hf).hom.app M).app U = M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (by simp [hf])).op := rfl

@[simp]
lemma restrictFunctorCongr_inv_app_app {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = g) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    [IsOpenImmersion g] (M : Y.Modules) :
    ((restrictFunctorCongr hf).inv.app M).app U = M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (by simp [hf])).op := rfl

/-- Restriction along open immersions commutes with taking stalks. -/
def restrictStalkNatIso (x : X) :
    restrictFunctor f ⋙ toPresheaf _ ⋙ TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor _ x ≅
    toPresheaf _ ⋙ TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor _ (f x) :=
  haveI := Functor.initial_of_adjunction (f.isOpenEmbedding.adjunctionNhds x)
  (toPresheaf _ ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringLeft (OpenNhds (f x))ᵒᵖ Y.Opensᵒᵖ Ab).obj
      (OpenNhds.inclusion (f x)).op).isoWhiskerLeft

@[simp]
lemma germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app (x : X) (M : Y.Modules) (hxU : x ∈ U) :

  haveI := Functor.initial_of_adjunction (f.isOpenEmbedding.adjunctionNhds x)
  Functor.Final.ι_colimitIso_hom
    (f.isOpenEmbedding.functorNhds x).op
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion ((ConcreteCategory.hom f.base) x)).op ⋙ M.presheaf) _

def pushforward : X.Modules ⥤ Y.Modules :=
  SheafOfModules.pushforward f.toRingCatSheafHom

@[simp]
lemma pushforward_obj_obj (M : X.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) :
    Γ((pushforward f).obj M, U) = Γ(M, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := rfl

@[simp]
lemma pushforward_obj_presheaf_map {U V : Y.Opens} (i : U ⟶ V) :
    ((pushforward f).obj M).presheaf.map i.op = M.presheaf.map ((Opens.map f.base).map i).op := rfl

lemma pushforward_map_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ((pushforward f).map φ).app U = φ.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) := rfl

/-- The pullback functor for categories of sheaves of modules over schemes. -/
def pullback : Y.Modules ⥤ X.Modules :=
  SheafOfModules.pullback f.toRingCatSheafHom

     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring
    11	
    12	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
    13	`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
    14	scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
    15	compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
    16	cohomology engine.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    28	
    29	/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
    30	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    31	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    32	    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
    33	  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)
    34	
    35	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections
    36	
    37	/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
    38	private noncomputable def smulSection
    39	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    40	    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
    41	  r • x
    42	
    43	/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
    44	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    45	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    46	    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
    48	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    49	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
    50	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    51	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
    53	          (congrArg
    54	            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
    55	              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
    56	            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
    57	  map_id U := by
    58	    ext x
    59	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
    60	      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
    61	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    62	    ext x
    63	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
    64	      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
    65	
    66	/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
    67	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    68	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    69	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
    70	      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
    71	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
    72	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    73	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl
    74	
    75	/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
    76	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    77	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    78	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    79	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩
    80	
    81	/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
    82	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    83	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    84	    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    85	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    86	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
    87	      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	namespace Modules
    91	
    92	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    93	
    94	/-- A scheme module which is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf. -/
    95	def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
    96	  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    97	    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    98	
    99	end Modules
   100	
   101	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

     9	# The rank-one evaluation zero-locus comparison
    10	
    11	The canonical inverse is cut out by the evaluation counit, while the existing divisor engine
    12	consumes the tied cocycle datum's local equations.  This file proves the section-level comparison
    13	between those two descriptions before any Noetherian or regularity hypothesis is introduced.
    14	
    15	For a tied local presentation, transporting a datum section through `module_iso.inv` commutes
    16	with restriction to every open.  Since every component of the sheaf isomorphism is injective,
    17	restriction vanishes on the module side exactly when it vanishes on the datum side.  Applying
    18	this to the canonical unit-lift through the evaluation counit identifies its restriction-
    19	vanishing predicate with that of `datumSection`.  The final theorem specializes the comparison
    20	to `PicRankOneNativePresentation`, whose converted module is definitionally the native module.
    21	
    22	This is the O-linear zero-locus seam needed before the datum-side local equations can be shown to
    23	cut out the intrinsic evaluation divisor.  It does not assert regularity, construct a family-level
    24	divisor, or manufacture the still-missing arbitrary-affine presentation producer.

    75	  rw [P.module_iso_inv_restrict h s]
    76	  exact map_eq_zero_iff _
    77	    (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    78	      (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op V))).1
    79	
    80	/-- The evaluation counit sends the canonical H⁰ unit-lift to the module section obtained
    81	from the tied datum class. -/
    82	theorem evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv
    83	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    84	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
    85	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
    86	      ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    87	        (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
    88	      (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := by
    89	  calc
    90	    _ = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
    91	    _ = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := rfl
    92	
    93	/-- The canonical evaluation section and the tied datum section have the same restriction-
    94	vanishing predicate on every open of the relative curve.
    95	
    96	This is the immediate consumer of `module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff`: the evaluated section
    97	is first identified with `moduleSectionsEquiv y`, then with the inverse image of
    98	`datumSection y` under the presentation's sheaf isomorphism. -/
    99	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   100	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   101	    {V : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
   102	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   103	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   104	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)))
   105	        P.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   106	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   107	        ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   108	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   109	        (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
   110	      ((P.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   111	        (P.datumSection y) = 0) := by
   112	  rw [P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0_eq_moduleSectionsEquiv y]
   113	  rw [← P.module_iso_inv_datumSection y]
   114	  exact P.module_iso_inv_restrict_eq_zero_iff h (P.datumSection y)
   115	
   116	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   117	
   118	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
   119	
   120	/-- Native specialization of the evaluation/datum zero-locus comparison.
   121	
   122	`toLocalPresentation.module` is definitionally `P.datum.nativeModule`, so this theorem is the
   123	consumer-facing native O-linear seam rather than a second choice of line bundle. -/
   124	theorem evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff
   125	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam)
   126	    {V : (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier).Opens} (h : V ≤ ⊤)
   127	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf 0) :
   128	    (((Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   129	      (Over.mk (relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
   130	        Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)))
   131	        P.toLocalPresentation.module).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   132	      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.toLocalPresentation.evaluation
   133	        ((relCurve C P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier ↘
   134	          Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   135	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.toLocalPresentation.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   136	        (P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLiftOfH0 y)) = 0) ↔
   137	      ((P.toLocalPresentation.datum.sheaf.obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
   138	        (P.toLocalPresentation.datumSection y) = 0) := by
   139	  exact P.toLocalPresentation.evaluationLift_restrict_eq_zero_iff h y
   140	
   141	end PicRankOneNativePresentation

     8	/-!
     9	# The canonical native rank-one presentation contract
    10	
    11	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` deliberately leaves the geometric producer fields explicit.
    12	This file fixes the module part of that contract: for a tied cocycle datum `D`, the module is
    13	always `D.nativeModule` and its base-ring comparison is always
    14	`D.nativeModuleKSheafIso`.  The native piece trivializations supply the line-bundle field;
    15	arbitrary-cartesian pushforward base change and the cohomology/rank certificates stay as
    16	explicit obligations.
    17	
    18	The resulting contract is therefore an adapter interface for a future producer, rather than a
    19	second choice of a line bundle.  Its conversion is consumed directly by the public
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` membership theorem below; no unrelated module or untied class can enter
    21	through this bridge, and the adapter itself does not provide the geometric certificates.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    30	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    41	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    42	
    43	/-! ## The native adapter contract -/
    44	
    45	/--
    46	A lambda-tied rank-one presentation whose module is canonically the native module of its
    47	cocycle datum.
    48	
    49	The fields after `datum_class` are exactly the remaining producer obligations.  The line-bundle
    50	certificate is derived from the canonical piece trivializations, so a field-level H⁰/H¹
    51	calculation or an unrelated line bundle cannot be silently substituted for the native
    52	evaluation module.
    53	-/
    54	structure PicRankOneNativePresentation
    55	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    56	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    57	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    58	  represents :
    59	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    60	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    61	  datum_class :
    62	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    63	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    64	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    65	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    66	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    67	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    68	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    69	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    70	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app datum.nativeModule)
    71	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    72	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    73	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    74	  h0_rank_one :
    75	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    76	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    77	
    78	namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation
    79	
    80	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    81	
    82	/-- Convert the native adapter contract to the existing local-presentation contract.
    83	
    84	The two native bridge fields are inserted definitionally; all other fields are transported
    85	without weakening or adding hypotheses.
    86	-/
    87	noncomputable def toLocalPresentation
    88	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
    89	    PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam :=
    90	  { cover := P.cover
    91	    representative := P.representative
    92	    represents := P.represents
    93	    datum := P.datum
    94	    datum_class := P.datum_class
    95	    module := P.datum.nativeModule
    96	    module_iso := P.datum.nativeModuleKSheafIso
    97	    line_bundle := P.datum.nativeModule_isLineBundle
    98	    native_pushforward_base_change := P.native_pushforward_base_change
    99	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
   100	    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
   101	    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
   102	    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }
   103	
   104	theorem nonempty_localPresentation
   105	    (P : PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :
   106	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :=
   107	  ⟨P.toLocalPresentation⟩
   108	
   109	end PicRankOneNativePresentation
   110	
   111	/-! ## Immediate rank-one-locus consumer -/
   112	
   113	/--
   114	An arbitrary-affine family of native contracts supplies the existing public rank-one-locus
   115	consumer.  The family is quantified in exactly the same way as
   116	`PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition`; the conversion only canonicalizes the module
   117	choice and does not manufacture any of the remaining geometric certificates.
   118	-/
   119	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations
   120	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   121	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   122	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   123	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
   124	        Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   125	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
   126	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   127	  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi
   128	  intro A _ _ t
   129	  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
   130	  exact P.nonempty_localPresentation
   131

    11	/-!
    12	# The consumed local divisor package for the rank-one route
    13	
    14	This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
    15	rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
    16	there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened
    17	effectivity engine packages those equations as a DivFamZarAff of degree genus C.
    18	
    19	The package is deliberately local and presentation-tied.  It does not define the canonical
    20	family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
    21	that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	
    26	universe u
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    29	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	open scoped TensorProduct
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    35	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    36	
    37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    38	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    39	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    40	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]

    43	
    44	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    45	
    46	/- The degree theorem needs the base-change geometric package under the local relCurve instance,
    47	   which has lower priority in the general curve API. -/
    48	noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) rankOneLocalDivisorOver
    49	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :

    52

    54	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    55	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
    56	  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L

    61	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L

    64	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :

    78	/-! ## Regularity and degree of the local equations -/
    79	
    80	/-- The local equations cut from the tied datum section remain regular after every field-valued
    81	coefficient extension.  This is the regularity input consumed by the widened effectivity
    82	engine, derived from the same fibrewise nonvanishing hypothesis used in the construction. -/
    83	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular
    84	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    85	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    86	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    87	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    88	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    89	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    90	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    91	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    92	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    93	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    94	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L]
    95	    (z : relCurve C L) :
    96	    ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
    97	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
    98	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).opens z) z
    99	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
   100	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).mem_opens z)).hom
   101	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
   102	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)

   104	      nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C L).presheaf.stalk z) := by

   106	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   107	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   108	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   109	  have hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   110	      D.sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   111	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0 :=
   112	    fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q
   113	  have hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (q : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
   114	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   115	    fun j q => D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   116	      s q (hsec q) j
   117	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   118	  exact D.germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
   119	    s hfib L z

   346	/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
