   348	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
   349	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   350	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   351	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   352	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   353	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   354	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   355	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   356	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   357	    abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
   358	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   359	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   360	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   361	  let B := Localization.Away f
   362	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   363	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   364	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
   365	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k
   366	  let F := P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy
   367	  have hFclass : F.picClass = (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass :=
   368	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
   369	  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
   370	      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   371	    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
   372	    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
   373	        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
   374	      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_

   354	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   355	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   356	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :

   358	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)

   360	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by

   363	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k

   365	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k

     9	# Zariski gluing of WIDENED locally certified divisor classes (R2 keystone, I-0492)
    10	
    11	**The pinned keystone, ported to the widened carrier** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2 at
    12	`DivFamZarAff`): compatible widened locally certified divisor classes over a finite away cover of
    13	`R` glue to a widened class over `R` restricting to them.
    14	
    15	## Why this ports, and where the only real work was
    16	
    17	R2 (human decision I-0492) widened where the certificate's pieces live ON THE CURVE — arbitrary
    18	affine opens instead of basic opens of two pinned `P¹` charts.  It changed NOTHING about the
    19	Zariski cover of the BASE, and the gluing argument is entirely about the base: it assembles a
    20	divisor with `awayGluedEquationsLoc` and witnesses local certifiability by `mapAlg` of the input
    21	families.  So the route below is the chart-typed `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat` with three
    22	mechanical substitutions — `DivFamZar → DivFamZarAff`, `CertifiedDivisorFamily →
    23	CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff`, and no `π` anywhere — plus two real costs:
    24	
    25	* the assembly had to be **restated at bare local-equation systems** first, because its
    26	  chart-typed statement demands `CertifiedDivisorFamily` input that a widened class provably
    27	  cannot supply.  That is `DivisorFamilyAffGlueZarKit.lean`; the proof there is verbatim.
    28	* every `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.mapAlg` carries the overlap-affineness argument `hinf`, free
    29	  here from `[IsProper C.hom]` via `AffCoverData.hasAffineOverlaps_of_isProper`, which is also
    30	  what `DivFamZarAff.mapAlg` itself needs.  Hence `[IsProper C.hom]` in the statement — the DD-R
    31	  lane has it everywhere, the challenge curve being proper over `k`.
    32	
    33	## The route, unchanged from the chart-typed keystone
    34	
    35	Representatives `d i` carry widened local certificate covers `h i : Fin (m i) → S i` with
    36	certified families `G i l` over `Localization.Away (h i l)`.  The composite cover
    37	`r ⟨i, l⟩ := a i l * g i` (numerators `a i l` of the `h i l`, `IsLocalization.Away.sec`) spans `⊤`
    38	(`span_range_num_mul_eq_top`), and the fine carriers `Localization.Away (h i l)` are
    39	`r ⟨i, l⟩`-away localizations of `R`.  The fine overlap carriers receive the coarse overlap
    40	carriers `T i j` by `IsLocalization.Away.lift`; the fine compatibility follows from the class-level
    41	compatibility pulled to the fine overlaps through the two factorizations of each comparison.  The
    42	widened certified-input gluing core produces the glued class, and the restriction law at the
    43	coarse level follows by Zariski separation (`DivFamZarAff.eq_of_away_eq`) over each `S i` against
    44	its fine cover.

   305	/-- **The widened divisor-functor map on locally certified classes** along an ARBITRARY test
   306	change: pull back the representative (the widened mapAlg-hreg engine discharges regularity) and
   307	transport the certificates.  Well defined by `divEq_pullback`.
   308	
   309	With this, `DivFamZarAff` is a functor value: the field-uniform carrier of R2 base-changes
   310	exactly as the chart-typed one did. -/

   312	    DivFamZarAff C R n → DivFamZarAff C R' n :=

   316	          (dp.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' n))
   317	        (dp.2.pullback R' n _))
   318	    (fun _ _ h => DivFamZarAff.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
   319	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R R') h _ _))

   568	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   569	    P.h0BaseChange B
   570	  exact one_tmul_linearEquiv_ne_zero eH0
   571	    ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) hy

   573	/-- The canonical scalar-extension certificate package attached to a tied presentation.
   574	
   575	The presentation's own `H¹`-vanishing, finite/projective `H⁰`, and stalk-rank-one fields are
   576	transported along its canonical `h0BaseChange` equivalence.  In particular, the target module
   577	is not replaced by an unrelated witness: it is exactly the datum module of `P.datum.baseChange`.
   578	This is a coefficient-extension feeder for the family producer; it does not assert the missing
   579	native pushforward base-change isomorphism or construct a presentation over a new affine test.
   580	-/
   581	theorem baseChangeRankOneCertificates
   582	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   583	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   584	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   585	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 1) ∧
   586	      Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) ∧
   587	      Module.Projective B (Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) ∧
   588	      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
   589	        Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   590	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   591	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   592	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   593	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair P.datum).H1 :=
   594	    (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing
   595	  have hh1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 1) :=
   596	    P.datum.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange B hH1
   597	  let e : B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q ≃ₗ[B]
   598	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 := P.h0BaseChange B
   599	  letI : Module.Finite B (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) := by
   600	    infer_instance
   601	  letI : Module.Projective B (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) := by
   602	    infer_instance
   603	  have hfin : Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) :=
   604	    Module.Finite.equiv e
   605	  have hproj : Module.Projective B (Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) :=
   606	    Module.Projective.of_equiv e
   607	  have hrank : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
   608	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) p = 1 := by
   609	    intro p
   610	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e, Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   611	    exact P.h0_rank_one (p.comap (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B))
   612	  exact ⟨hh1, hfin, hproj, hrank⟩

   614	/-- `H¹`-vanishing in a presentation propagates to every coefficient extension. -/
   615	private theorem datumPair_h1_baseChange
   616	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)

   618	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :

   623	/-- The local-away generator supplied over the presentation ring gives the exact
   624	fibrewise-nonvanishing hypothesis required by the divisor construction after localizing.

   627	`sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange`.  It compares residue fields across the
   628	localization, cancels the iterated tensor product, and then uses the presentation's
   629	canonical `H⁰` base-change equivalence. -/
   630	theorem sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero
   631	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   632	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   633	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   634	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   635	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   636	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   637	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   638	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   639	    (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).sectionsMapTop
   640	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   641	      (P.datumSectionBaseChange (Localization.Away f) y) ≠ 0 := by
   642	  let B := Localization.Away f
   643	  let K := q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   644	  have hiter : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B]
   645	      ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) :
   646	      K ⊗[B] (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   647	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)) ≠ 0 :=
   648	    away_one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero f y hy q
   649	  have hyB : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B]
   650	      (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)) :
   651	      K ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) ≠ 0 :=
   652	    P.h0BaseChange_one_tmul_ne_zero B K y hiter
   653	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair (P.datum.baseChange B)).H1 :=
   654	    P.datumPair_h1_baseChange B
   655	  let yB : Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   656	    P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)
   657	  change (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop K
   658	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   659	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   660	      isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf yB) ≠ 0
   661	  exact sectionsMapTop_ne_zero_of_one_tmul_ne_zero
   662	    (P.datum.baseChange B) hH1 yB hyB

   664	/-- A rank-one presentation has a tied local-away evaluation generator.
   665	
   666	The rank-one field of `P` makes every residue-field fibre of its `H⁰` module nontrivial.
   667	The projective-module generator lemma therefore supplies a single basic open `D(f)` and
   668	one datum section `y` which stays nonzero on every residue fibre over that open.  The same
   669	`y` is transported to a native global section and its unit-lift through the evaluation
   670	counit; the final conjunct records that counit identity explicitly so the future
   671	`divisorOfRankOne` construction consumes this witness rather than an unrelated section.
   672	-/
   673	theorem exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator
   674	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   675	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   676	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   677	      ∃ y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0,
   678	        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   679	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   680	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   681	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   682	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   683	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   684	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   685	          (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   686	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   687	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   688	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   689	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   690	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) = 1 := by
   691	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]
   692	    exact P.h0_rank_one p
   693	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) :=
   694	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   695	  haveI : Nontrivial (Q ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   696	    (TensorProduct.comm P.cover.Carrier _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   697	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy⟩ :=
   698	    Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p (Q := Q)
   699	      (by infer_instance)
   700	  refine ⟨f, hf, y, ?_, ?_⟩
   701	  · simpa only [Q] using hy
   702	  · exact P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y

   708	Together with `exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator`, this is the immediate local divisor
   709	consumer on the datum side.  Identifying it with the native evaluation zero locus remains
   710	a separate `O`-module base-change contract. -/
